description: An attenuverter with an offset: it scales the input, inverts it if the knob is turned back, and adds a fixed voltage

params.text: Scales the input, -1 to +1; at the centre nothing of the input passes, clockwise it passes through, anticlockwise it passes inverted
Adds a fixed voltage to the scaled signal, -5V to 5V

inputs.text: The signal to be scaled, taken with all its polyphonic channels

outputs.text: The input scaled by ATT with OFF added, clamped to ±12V, and with as many channels as the input

notes: with nothing patched to IN the module is a manual voltage source, the OFF knob alone setting the output
the lamp glows green while the first channel of the output is positive and red while it is negative
